title: US and Denmark reach deal over Greenland after Trump annexation threats
description: Trump said the agreement will give the US "permanent control over security, and all other needs, in Greenland", though specifics haven't been confirmed by Danish officials.

title: 'I'm telling the truth': Earl Spencer defends Diana book claims about Charles in BBC interview
description: Princess Diana's brother tells the BBC's Laura Kuenssberg that "we'll forget her soon enough" were "exactly" the words used by the then-Prince of Wales.

title: Watch: Diana's brother says Charles 'went ballistic' in phone call after her death
description: Earl Spencer spoke exclusively with the BBC's Laura Kuenssberg about claims he has made in a new book.

title: Flight chaos caused by software defect in space of a millisecond, report says
description: The failure led to more than 2,000 flights being cancelled and hundreds of thousands of passengers affected.

title: Billionaire Man United owner says he has lost confidence in the UK
description: Ineos founder Sir Jim Ratcliffe tells the BBC he thinks the country is "on the slide" and calls for more investment in the North Sea.

title: Trump says he is banning CNN and Politico from White House
description: The US president has had a tense and fiery relationship with the US media throughout his political career.

title: MI5 accepts it gave evidence based on lies in neo-Nazi spy case
description: It is the first time MI5 has confirmed the BBC's revelation that it gave evidence based on lies in court while defending the violent informant.

title: Teen who piloted Channel boat with 165 migrants jailed
description: Chan Mathok Atak has been sentenced to two years and three months in prison after piloting the boat.

title: Brother didn't match description of 'Putney pusher', suspect's sisters tell BBC
description: Speaking on BBC Radio 4's Today programme, Nicholas Brandram's sisters accused the Metropolitan Police of being "negligent and reckless".
